item.subject: maths
item.stem:
The diagram shows kite $ABCD$ that Bharti draws. Equal marks show $AB=BC$ and $AD=DC$. Diagonal $BD$ is drawn solid; diagonal $AC$ is dashed.

Which claim about the kite and its special diagonal is correct?

options.A: The kite has all four sides equal because the diagram shows four sides.
options.B: Diagonal $AC$ is the axis of symmetry of the kite.
options.C: Diagonal $BD$ is the axis of symmetry; it bisects $AC$ at right angles.
options.D: The figure is a kite because it is labelled $ABCD$.
